documents.title: Node.js API reference
documents.content: Node.js provides built-in modules for filesystem access, HTTP servers and asynchronous streams. The API reference documents these module interfaces and runtime behavior.

documents.title: PgBouncer connection pooling
documents.content: PgBouncer pools PostgreSQL database connections. Transaction pooling reuses a server connection after each transaction, while session pooling retains a connection for a client session.

documents.title: Redis cache expiration
documents.content: Redis caches application data in memory. Cache expiration uses a TTL, and invalidation removes stale entries. Connection configuration affects the Redis client, not PostgreSQL pooling.

documents.title: Playwright browser waits
documents.content: Playwright uses Chromium to render browser pages. The domcontentloaded event marks document parsing, while networkidle waits for network connections to become idle.

documents.title: SQLite crash recovery
documents.content: SQLite WAL journal mode supports crash recovery for database writes. A checkpoint transfers committed records from the write-ahead log into the main database file.

documents.title: Docker Compose volume isolation
documents.content: Docker Compose project names isolate named volumes between test stacks. A disposable test project should remove its own volumes after checking the runtime, while keeping development data.

documents.title: PostgreSQL bağlantı havuzu
documents.content: PostgreSQL bağlantı havuzu, istemci bağlantılarını yeniden kullanır. İşlem sonunda bağlantı havuza döner. Havuz kapasitesi sınırlıdır ve bekleyen istekler için zaman aşımı uygulanır.

documents.title: Embedding queue limits
documents.content:
Embedding queue limits bound waiting inference work. Active inference is serialized and queued requests have a fixed capacity. Cancellation signals waiting tasks and prevents late writes.
